Paragraph:
Translation: Therefore, without being attached to the fruits of activities, one should act as a matter of duty; for by working without attachment, one attains the Supreme.

Purport (Excerpt): ...acting... under proper guidance and without attachment to the result of the work, is certainly making progress toward the supreme goal of life. Arjuna is told that he should fight... for the interest of Krsna... To be a good man or a nonviolent man is a personal attachment, but to act on behalf of the Supreme is to act without attachment...
Situation/Problem_Faced: The practical struggle of executing difficult daily duties without getting emotionally consumed by outcomes.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna provides the core command of Karma-yoga: Perform work continuously as a matter of duty (karyam karma) without attachment to rewards, as unattached work leads directly to the Supreme.
Outcome/Resolution: Arjuna receives the foundational mindset required to perform his challenging duty on the battlefield without anxiety or moral corruption.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Process Orientation: Focusing on executing the present task rather than obsessing over future results
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Detached Commitment: Engaging deeply in effort while releasing emotional grip on the outcome
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Duty-Centered Living: Guided by core values and obligations rather than personal likes and dislikes

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Asakto hy acaran karma (Performing work without attachment)
Param apnoti purusah (Attaining the Supreme state through unattached action)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Krishna instructs Arjuna to carry out his daily duties strictly as an obligation without clinging to personal results. Working with detachment elevates consciousness and brings one to ultimate liberation.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Anxiety is caused by attaching your emotional identity to outcomes you cannot completely control. Shifting focus from results to the quality of execution frees mental energy, lowers stress, and improves performance.
